name: Signal Transform Expansion Inventory
summary: Declarative refinements for windowing, forward transforms, spectral processing, and inverse transforms.

operations.name: Analyze Window Leakage
operations.intent: Measure spectral leakage introduced by windowing before downstream spectral processing.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for excessive leakage after applying a window.

rewrite.before_summary: Windowing feeds the forward transform path directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A window-leakage analysis stage is inserted after windowing.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds leakage evidence before spectral interpretation.

operations.name: Detect Spectral Aliasing
operations.intent: Check for high energy near Nyquist after the forward transform.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add an aliasing check after the forward transform.

rewrite.before_summary: The forward transform feeds spectral processing directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A spectral-aliasing detection stage is inserted after the forward transform.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds sampling-limit evidence before spectral processing.

operations.name: Validate Parseval Energy
operations.intent: Check energy consistency after spectral processing.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add an energy-conservation check after spectral processing.

rewrite.before_summary: Spectral processing feeds the inverse or downstream path directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A Parseval energy validation stage is inserted after spectral processing.

operations.name: Check Inverse Reconstruction
operations.intent: Verify round-trip fidelity after inverse transformation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a reconstruction check after the inverse transform.

rewrite.before_summary: The inverse transform feeds the downstream result directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A reconstruction-quality check is inserted after the inverse transform.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds round-trip fidelity evidence for the transformed signal.

audit.rationale: Externalizes implemented signal transform expansion operations into provider-owned declarative assets.
audit.dejargonized_summary: These are checks that make transform pipelines more explicit when leakage, aliasing, energy mismatch, or reconstruction error may affect the result.

references.title: Matcher signal_transform expansion rules
references.note: Rule names and trigger metrics mirror sciona/principal/expansion_rules/signal_transform.py.
